data.body: ADDITIONAL FINDING from manual redistribution attempt on PR #140: Trailer-based partition is insufficient. Commit 6def60b4c2 has 'DSO-Story: 5921 (S3)' trailer but adds resolve-session-branch.sh which is S5's deliverable. Commit 964e7a6279 has 'DSO-Story: 8e8a (S5)' trailer but adds test-check-ruleset-preflight.sh which is S3's test. Parallel sub-agents in a shared session worktree produce commits where the trailer reflects the AGENT's assigned story but the diff CONTENT spans story boundaries. Tool needs file-content-aware partitioning or temporal chunking fallback. See bug detail for design options 1-3.
